headline: Texas Roadhouse Expands Franchise Deals to Vietnam and Japan
summary: Texas Roadhouse expanded its brand footprint through franchise deals in Vietnam and Japan, enabling international growth without heavy capital investment.
why: Asset-light franchise expansion models allow restaurant chains to scale international operations while minimizing capital expenditure outlays.

impacts.name: Texas Roadhouse Inc
impacts.why: International franchise agreements provide new royalty revenue streams with limited capital risk.
